description: The flag follows the degree, not the person. An applicant who studied civil engineering at a designated university carries the same flag as one who studied something sensitive.
energy_note: A permanent mark acquired at 18 by choosing a university.

description: Some destination countries restrict Iranian nationals from nuclear, aerospace and certain materials programmes; the UK ATAS scheme screens postgraduate applicants in listed subjects and Iranian applicants are disproportionately refused.
notes: ATAS exists and is documented; the Iranian refusal rate assertion is NOT verified here. Layer-5 target - ATAS refusal statistics by nationality.
